title: 5d-7: orient constraint section
description:
## Parent

sutra/68 — 5d PRD: constraint system + DD integration

## What to build

Add a constraints section to `sutra_orient` output. When an agent asks for orientation on an area, include: active constraints scoped to that area, any active waivers, and any current violations. Follows the same scope-resolution logic as convention orientation (5c-9).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Orient output includes constraints section
- [ ] Constraints with kind, severity, name, provenance
- [ ] Active waivers shown
- [ ] Current violations listed
- [ ] Scope resolution matches convention orient pattern

## Blocked by

- sutra/70 — 5d-2: constraint types + rules parsing
- sutra/73 — 5d-5: constraint waivers (DB)

acceptance_criteria.text: sutra_orient output includes a constraints section listing active constraints scoped to the target area
Constraints shown with kind, severity, name (if set), provenance (if set)
Active waivers in the target area shown alongside constraints
Current violations in the target area listed
Scope resolution: path-prefix constraints match files in scope, component constraints match via membership
Follows same scope-resolution pattern as convention orientation
